text: Live caption capture: activate captions (More actions -> Language and speech -> Turn on live captions); inject MutationObserver on data-tid=closed-caption-renderer-wrapper with terminal-punctuation dedup; AddBinding(sendCaptionToGo)+ListenTarget bridge; stream to transcript.Writer. Acceptance: TestMeetingEnableCaptions passes.

Audio capture + MP3: getDisplayMedia({audio,video}); isolate audio track; MediaRecorder chunks -> base64 over sendAudioToGo binding; pure-Go MP3 encode (shine-mp3); stream to .mp3. Acceptance: TestMeetingCaptureAudio passes.

chromeMeeting.Join: split chromedp.Navigate from pre-join WaitVisible into separate Run steps and validate MeetingURL up front, so navigation failures surface a distinct error from 'pre-join not visible'. Copilot PR#7 follow-up.
